name: Springfield

zones.N: North side of Mountain Ave (trash Friday; Tuesday & Friday in summer)
zones.S: South side of Mountain Ave (trash Thursday; Monday & Thursday in summer)

notes: Trash is picked up by Regional Industries (included in your taxes): Thursday on the south side of Mountain Ave, Friday on the north side; from May 26 to September 4, Monday and Thursday on the south side and Tuesday and Friday on the north side. A pickup that falls on a holiday (New Year's Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas) is made the next day. Missed pickup: Regional Industries, 908-436-1966.

Recycling is weekly, single stream, by Giordano: put the bin out the night before or by 6 AM. Clean plastics #1, #2 and #5, glass, aluminum, cardboard boxes (flattened and tied), newspapers, magazines, soft-cover books and junk mail, all in one bin. No packing peanuts, Styrofoam, shredded paper or plastic bags of any kind; recycling in plastic bags is not collected. Giordano does not provide bins: use a blue bin of 32 to 64 gallons, or label another color "RECYCLING". On a holiday, recycling moves to the next day. Missed recycling: Giordano, 973-242-2250 ext. 2 (Monday-Friday 8:30 AM-3:00 PM).

Bulk waste is picked up on March 18, June 10, September 16 and December 9, 2026: put it out the Tuesday evening before; it is collected over the next two days. No construction debris, electronics or branches, and nothing over 3 x 3 x 12 feet.
Christmas trees are picked up at the curb through January (no artificial trees, stands, lights, decorations, wire or plastic bags).
Spring cleanup: in April, DPW crews pick up branches up to 4 inches across, leaves and grass in paper bags or cans; loose debris in the road is not picked up.

Leaves: November 1 to December 31, 2026. On township roads you may put leaves in the street from October 23, at least 10 feet from a storm drain; only leaves and grass, no branches. Union County picks up leaves on county roads (908-789-3660).

Recycling Convenience Center at the Springfield Municipal Pool, 44 Morrison Road, open all year (staff Monday, Wednesday and Friday 7:30-11:30 AM): electronics, branches under 4 inches in the proper bin, leaves, grass and soft yard waste, and clean white Styrofoam (no food foam). Free mulch for residents.

Household hazardous waste, paper shredding (March 21, June 13, October 17 at the pool, 9 AM-1 PM) and county drop-offs: Union County Recycling, 908-654-9889. Dry out latex paint and put it in your trash with the lid off.
sources: Township of Springfield, 2026 DPW Services Brochure (May 2026 edition; the January one had summer May 27 - August 29), checked 2026-11-21: https://springfield-nj.us/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2026-DPW-Services-Brochure.pdf ; its make-up Saturday for Thanksgiving trash differs from Recycle Coach (next day, Friday November 27), which is used
Public Works page (bulk dates, Christmas trees until January 31, leaves from October 23): https://springfield-nj.us/departments/public-works/

Recycling days: the brochure says to check the website, which does not give them; Thursday (south) and Friday (north) like trash is an assumption, from its holiday note that Thursday's recycling moves to Friday
